title: Calculus Volume 1
author: OpenStax
subject: Mathematics
description: Calculus Volume 1 covers functions, limits, derivatives, and integration. Designed for a two- or three-semester calculus course appropriate for students majoring in mathematics, science, or engineering.

title: Biology 2e
author: OpenStax
subject: Biology
description: Biology 2e covers the scope and sequence of a typical two-semester biology course. Provides comprehensive coverage of foundational research and core biology concepts through an evolutionary lens.

title: Algebra and Trigonometry
author: OpenStax
subject: Mathematics
description: A comprehensive exploration of algebraic principles meeting scope and sequence requirements for a typical introductory algebra and trigonometry course.

title: Introduction to Psychology
author: OpenStax
subject: Psychology
description: A comprehensive survey of the scientific study of human behavior and mental processes, covering sensation, perception, states of consciousness, motivation, developmental psychology, and more.

title: Principles of Economics 2e
author: OpenStax
subject: Economics
description: Covers the scope and sequence of most introductory economics courses including microeconomics, macroeconomics, supply and demand, and international trade with current real-world examples.

title: Chemistry 2e
author: OpenStax
subject: Chemistry
description: Meets the scope and sequence of a two-semester general chemistry course. Covers core chemistry concepts and how they apply to everyday life and future scientific study.

title: University Physics Volume 1
author: OpenStax
subject: Physics
description: Covers mechanics, sound, oscillations, and waves. Designed for the calculus-based physics course appropriate for students majoring in physics, engineering, or related fields.

title: Introduction to Sociology 3e
author: OpenStax
subject: Sociology
description: Aligns with a typical introductory sociology course, providing a rigorous introduction to sociology's theory and application with updated examples and research.

title: Statistics
author: OpenStax
subject: Mathematics
description: Designed for introductory statistics courses across a wide variety of majors. Emphasizes real-world applications and statistical literacy over pure mathematical derivation.

title: Computer Science: An Interdisciplinary Approach
author: Robert Sedgewick and Kevin Wayne
subject: Computer Science
description: A modern introduction to computer science emphasizing the relationship between programming and its mathematical and scientific foundations. Covers Java, algorithms, and data structures.
